annotations.title: What is this mine’s safety record?

description: Look up a U.S. mine on the Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) register by its 7-digit mine ID or by name (optionally with a two-letter state): status, commodity, controller and operator (organisations only), and its record since 2000: inspections, citations and orders (significant and substantial), proposed and paid penalties, accidents and fatal accidents.

limit.description: Most mines to return for a name search (default 10, max 50).

name.description: Mine name or part of it, e.g. "Brierfield Quarry".
